intuition: Authors state aqueous hydrazine acts as a crystallization medium rather than reacting with CoS.
Authors describe a reversible solution-to-solid route enabling atom rearrangement; this is a proposed interpretation, not a measured pathway.
The source reports separate 6 mL reagent charge and 1.4 kmol m−3 optimum concentration; it does not show a calculation linking them.
scopeLabel: Full three-page main-paper route; SI not supplied, reviewed or used.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
